evidence: Whitney is never a Council of Nine member before she seizes it, so the second stage (Council of Nine before Isodyne) is wrong. The Council then tries to have her killed, and she absorbs Chadwick and three members and takes control of the Council. Through S1 episodes 1-5 he is a cop with no tie to Fisk, and he first serves Fisk in episode 6 ('Excessive Force'), when Fisk recruits him, North and the others into the Anti-Vigilante Task Force. This is the same fix already made to Cole North's record (T:st-cole-north), which now reads NYPD, AVTF, Fisk's Empire. His last stage does not change.
